text:
Maria: heads up — ACME reported repeated SSE disconnects when users switch from WiFi -> cellular midstream. Partial chunks delivered then socket closes. Repro on Android 13. session_id: s-907ab. Can we triage?
Devon: can you paste the client logs + server event ids? my first guess is token refresh race or proxy idle timeout.
Maria: client snippet: 
```
[SSE] connected
[SSE] event: data chunk
[SSE] error: ECONNRESET
[SSE] closed by peer
```
server side shows a 401 during the reconnect attempt: `GET /v1/stream?sid=s-907ab 401 {"error":"token_expired"}`. Token TTL set to 60s, client tries refresh at ~62s.
Rina: mobile note — Android sometimes pauses the streaming read thread during network handover (Doze-ish behavior). If the token rotates while socket is transient, client will resume without valid creds and server rejects.
Devon: that aligns. Two mitigation options: 1) client preemptive refresh while streaming (refresh earlier), 2) server accepts previous token for short grace window during rotation. Which is doable?
Maria: customer is worried about billing — partial output counted as full. @Sam can billing hold any credits while we investigate?
Sam: billing policy: we bill per token emitted. Partial output is billable. We can make exceptions for confirmed server faults; need concrete evidence (request/response logs).
Devon: quick repro I ran locally: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream?session=s-907ab"
# toggle WiFi off
# result: HTTP/1.1 200 then midstream JSON error {"type":"error","code":401,"msg":"token_expired"} then connection close
```
Maria: ACME repro steps I documented:
- Start a long streaming prompt (>30s)
- Toggle WiFi off (force carrier)
- Observe ~8-15s later the stream closes with partial data
- Device log: token refresh attempted only after connection resumed
Rina: quick Android workaround: keep streaming in a small foreground service or do proactive token refresh every 45s while streaming. That prevents the race.
Devon: server-side mitigation: accept previous token for ~20s after rotation on stream endpoints, emit periodic `ping` events every 15s to keep NAT/proxies alive, and return SSE meta `retry` so clients backoff gracefully. I'll draft a PR.
Maria: customer needs ETA and suggested client changes. Can eng + mobile give a short blurb we can send?
Devon: I'll open PR to add 20s token-grace on streaming endpoints + periodic pings. ETA: EOD today for staging test. :hammer_and_wrench:
Rina: I'll prepare a one-paragraph mobile snippet for ACME with code hint: "while (streaming) { if (now - lastRefresh > 45s) refreshToken(); }" and note foreground service suggestion.
Maria: thanks — I'll reply to ACME with repro steps, mitigation, and ask them to try the client patch. Also asking billing to hold any manual credits until we confirm root cause.
stream-bot: Deploy job #4521 started by Devon — token-grace feature to staging.
Sam: billing will hold adjustments pending root-cause confirmation. :white_check_mark:
Maria: closing loop once staging looks good, will post update here.
